H_protocol: H1 actual literal events; H2 amplified disposition with transfer-intensity caution; H3 requires actual behavior too dependent on a local punchline to generalize, H4 actual nonliteral behavioral license. Staging, metaphors, world magic, genre expectations, sexual misreadings and unknown causes do not by themselves establish H3/H4.
L_protocol: L0 portable propositions; L1 material wording/rhythm; L2 register/pragmatic force; L3 central Japanese form requiring reconstruction/annotation. No automatic L3 for idiom/script/names. No forced category quota.

records.whole_selected_premise: The happy returning exile is the princess herself, but her actual instruction was to cool her head and learn outside.

records.H_rationale: Rionor actually joins the trip and competes for space, while Dust interprets possible parental respite.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No identical formal exile decree, adventurer registration or Axis-priest appointment is shown.

records.whole_selected_premise: The desired two-woman attention produces anxiety, and an observer retracts his envy after looking at the actual scene.
records.L_rationale: Only-for-a-while limits the lifelong celibacy prediction, and no-right-answer names recipient pressure.
records.H_rationale: Both women choose arm contact, Dust is uncomfortable and child adds nonsexual partner attachment.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No mouth kiss, marriage or settled triangle; adult service comment non-graphic and child is not an adult romantic rival.

records.whole_selected_premise: The supposedly defeated devil wakes in the patients room without bonds, spared partly by comparison with the princess.
records.L_rationale: Reported royal judgment separates pragmatic lenience from the devils own admission of destructive intent.
records.H_rationale: Gaibil is alive/bandaged, Doreck reports his plea and future service instruction.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Attributed no-human-harm defense does not erase actual earlier captivity, shock and church damage; Dust is absent.

records.whole_selected_premise: The perfect villain boast is broken by coughing, and comfortable envy leads to a new wish for personal merit.
records.L_rationale: All-as-planned denial answers explicit gratitude, then the new own-appeal wish changes the means sought.
records.H_rationale: Actual friendship, reversed patient care and a new handshake replace proxy marriage with a growth request.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No complete cure, guaranteed marriage, printed new price/refund or proof every earlier action was planned; private epilogue not Dust knowledge.

records.whole_selected_premise: A supposedly finished seven-volume story returns under more, with a discarded setting and deliberately stronger new character traits.
records.L_rationale: Supposed-to-have-ended and the self-interrupted preference comment are material creator wording.
records.H_rationale: Author explains production choices and two recognizable influences.
records.eligibility_and_limits: Creator plane, no narrative volume8 or canon visit to the abandoned candidate; cough is rhetorical rather than medical evidence.

records.whole_selected_premise: Thanks for physically picking up the book repairs into purchasing because the audience may be electronic.
records.L_rationale: The metapragmatic repair accommodates actual medium and recipient access.
records.H_rationale: Author closes with credited roles and a changed thanks formula.
records.eligibility_and_limits: No root acquisition certification, native-human voice test, anime viewing or independent character trial.
